name: Menherafflesia
source:
A story where the protagonist, Itarou, grows five types of flowers. Let's make the dreaming flowers bloom here now...

[Translated from [url=https://nekocharon.jp/menhera.html]Main Website[/url]]
translation:
一個主角伊太郎培育五種花朵的故事。就在此刻，讓夢中的花朵在這裡盛開吧……
